verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents an official MCP server that users add to their AI assistant. Setup uses a browser-based OAuth flow where the user logs in, reviews the requested access, and picks a workspace. Service keys scoped to specific tasks support headless agent and MCP use, and a probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page. Missing for 10: documentation of which tools or actions the MCP server exposes and which assistant clients it supports, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as described.
